sections.heading: Second fear of failure
sections.content: Customers fear learning something after the contract is signed that makes their decision seem unwise. Dixon’s example: an early-stage tech company won a seven-figure deal, but a Gartner Magic Quadrant published about two weeks later placed it mid-pack. After stakeholders challenged the CTO’s choice, the client backed out. Dixon says customers may keep researching because they do not want to be surprised by new information.
